subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the rank of the 3 × 4 matrix with rows (1, 2, 0, −1), (3, 4, 1, 2) and (−2, 3, 2, 5).

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the rank of this 3 × 4 matrix.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Reduce to echelon form
steps.margin_note: First mark. A 3 × 4 matrix has no determinant of its own, so row reduction is the working method. The rank cannot pass 3, because there are only 3 rows.
steps.memory_tip: A non-square matrix has no determinant — reduce it to echelon form instead.
lines: The matrix is 3 × 4, so Rank A ≤ 3.

recall.must_convey: That the matrix is reduced to echelon form by named row operations, because a 3 × 4 matrix has no determinant.
accept: reduce it to echelon form using row operations
R two minus three R one and R three plus two R one, then clear the second column
there is no determinant for a three by four matrix so row reduce it
row operations tho echelon form ki teesukuraavali
make zeros below the first pivot and then below the second
heard_as: R two minus three R one

steps.why: Row operations do not change the rank, so the echelon form has the same rank as the original matrix — and in echelon form the rank can simply be counted.
common_mistakes: Looking for a determinant of the whole 3 × 4 matrix.
Answering 4 because the matrix has four columns.

steps.label: Count the non-zero rows
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Three non-zero rows means rank 3, and the order-3 minor built from the first three columns confirms it. There is no minor of order 4, because there are only 3 rows.
steps.memory_tip: The number of non-zero rows in echelon form IS the rank.
lines: The echelon form has 3 non-zero rows.

recall.must_convey: That the echelon form has three non-zero rows, so the rank is 3, confirmed by a non-zero order-3 minor.
accept: three non zero rows so the rank is three
count the rows that are not all zeros, there are three, so rank three
the first three columns give a minor of minus eleven which is not zero so rank is three
zero kaani rows moodu unnayi kabatti rank three

steps.why: The count of non-zero rows in echelon form is the rank. Showing one non-zero minor of that same order is the check straight from the definition.
common_mistakes: Counting the rows of the original matrix instead of the echelon form.
Stopping the reduction before the shape is triangular.
